title: 冬のイラスト
subject_en: winter icons, each a separate object
lead: 雪、手ぶくろ、こたつ、みかん、ココア、マフラーなど、冬を感じる12点。おたよりやお店のお知らせ、冬のイベントの案内に。
items: a kotatsu table with a blanket and a mikan bowl
a mug of hot cocoa with marshmallows and steam
a snowman with a bucket hat
a hot pot (nabe) with steam and vegetables
a small kerosene heater with a kettle on top
icicles hanging from a roof edge
a red camellia flower with snow on leaves
